$description: Screen orientation as shipped, copied from the two style-guide artifacts (project/4-layout.md, iOS also project/README.md) on 2026-11-10. Source data: do not edit.

ios.source: MNG iOS Style Guide artifact (https://claude.ai/artifact/V364juyHFU3STfVZ6EgjMc), TroncKit @ e30ad2585, project/4-layout.md

tablet.how: Section fronts change layout by window width, not device (bp-front-small / medium / large)

foldable.how: No foldable or iPhone Duo handling

android.source: MNG Android Style Guide artifact (https://claude.ai/artifact/5MyLP13QSt52WGRgXW35ZJ), android-tribpub @ 1cfb069a6, project/4-layout.md

phone.how: Locked from code by Utils.disablePhoneLandscape() in MainActivity, articles, settings, gallery, paywall and web view; the manifest sets no orientation

tablet.how: values-sw500dp loads the tablet config (is_phone=false), but section fronts still render in phone mode (BaseMainActivity.isPhone() returns true)

foldable.how: No androidx.window, WindowSizeClass or fold handling; folding or unfolding recreates MainActivity
